title: Clamp Done Sensor Not Detected
description: Clamp command was issued but clamp done sensor did not turn ON.
recommended_first_check: Check clamp done sensor LED and bracket alignment

title: EtherCAT Slave Not OP
description: EtherCAT slave remains in PRE_OP or SAFE_OP after initialization.
recommended_first_check: Check link LED, station alias, ESI mismatch

title: Door Closed Sensor Mismatch
description: Door close command complete but closed sensor mismatch.
recommended_first_check: Check door close sensor and mechanical obstruction

title: FOUP Presence Inconsistent
description: FOUP presence sensor flickering or inconsistent.
recommended_first_check: Check presence sensor contamination and cable

title: Mapping Sensor Timeout
description: Wafer mapping did not finish in expected time.
recommended_first_check: Check mapping arm home sensor
